source: Phase 22 brief: the user and his older son solved N39-N47 together on a real iPhone and agreed on one assessment per board. ONE JOINT HUMAN EVALUATION - not two independent blind tests. Small-sample observation, not a validated difficulty label.
note: Boards, ids and fingerprints unchanged. The automated diagnostics did not predict both downgrades: N41 had the weakest diagnostics of the batch (look-6 greedy 0.31), but N46 had look-6 greedy 0.00 and 16 / 16 learner dead ends - the highest of the batch - and was still rated MEDIUM.
